subject.title: fix(webchat): preserve session context on first send after page load (#96331)

question: Should WebChat treat a successful `chat.history` load with a matching session id as permission for the next `chat.send` to reuse that session even when idle/daily freshness would otherwise rotate it?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the behavior deliberately changes the precedence between visible history continuity and configured session rollover, which is a product/session-state policy choice.

options.title: Accept loaded-history continuity
options.body: Approve a private one-shot resume after history load so the model sees the same context the UI displays, while preserving ordinary stale-send rollover without the marker.

options.title: Keep reset-first semantics
options.body: Require idle/daily rollover to win even after history load, and define UI disclosure or recovery for displayed history that will not be sent as model context.

options.title: Defer to gateway-side policy
options.body: Pause the UI marker approach and ask for an owner-approved gateway/session API that distinguishes caller-verified WebChat sessions from ordinary client-supplied session ids.

recommendation.title: Accept loaded-history continuity
recommendation.body: Approve a private one-shot resume after history load so the model sees the same context the UI displays, while preserving ordinary stale-send rollover without the marker.

likelyOwner.reason: The current active chat modules and refactor that made this PR stale are under the recent PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101193 history.
